measurement: First native Responses input usage from rollout token_count.info.last_token_usage minus the fixed empty-rule baseline. Only model_instructions_file content varies; cached input is recorded, never subtracted. turn.completed usage is diagnostic only.
isolation: same fresh HOME/CODEX_HOME/XDG/tmp/work for all invocations
same native configuration, model and user message
read-only with native rollouts retained privately
limits: Native CLI usage from the custom service is supplemental, not an official count endpoint result.
Only one completed turn with no tool use is accepted per invocation; the first response usage is measured separately from cumulative turn usage.
The CLI may include constant environment/envelope overhead; this is removed empirically by baseline subtraction.
Full serialized request bytes are not intercepted or claimed as verified.
No accuracy threshold, billing guarantee or production coefficient change.
rejected_measurement_reason: Native CLI trims the instruction file before loading it; the exact untrimmed equality guard correctly stopped this preflight. The successful model response is not a completed calibration.
